free_tier.stated: Free wafer-scale accelerator time on Cerebras CS-3 systems, allocated through the NSF ACCESS programme: 'There is no cost to use Neocortex for non-proprietary research.' Eligibility is explicit and institutional: 'Projects must be non-proprietary. Applicants must be a researcher or educator at a US academic or non-profit research institution. A principal investigator (PI) is required. PIs may not be a high school, undergraduate or graduate student; a qualified advisor must serve in this capacity.'

record.interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
record.chaining: The allocation is the only route to a CS-3 that does not involve a purchase, and it chains with publishing the result. It breaks at the PI requirement, which no amount of preparation substitutes for.

limits.value: a PI at a US academic or non-profit institution plus a reviewed ACCESS allocation request, so identity fails before any quota does.
